dimensions.note: The sweep reads its secret through the existing resolveSecret (registered with the redactor before use). The listing record type has a secret_key field (filled only on create); only an allow-list of fields is copied, and a test asserts neither the probe secret nor a planted secret_key value nor the string secret_key reaches a written resource. accessKey is an identifier, annotated with a quality-ignore and a comment saying why.
One info line per sweep with status and key count; a warn line naming vault/key (never a value) when the secret cannot be read. No per-key logging.

Found and fixed during review: a key repeated across offset pages (a key minted mid-sweep) would have counted toward total_count and hidden a key never seen. Access keys are now de-duplicated, the listing is ordered by created_at_asc, and a short listing is `unreachable`, with a test. Every failure path (no/bad org id, ambiguous or missing credential, vault miss, 401, 400, 403, 5xx, non-JSON, missing fields, bad access_key, unparseable expires_at, short or non-terminating listing) writes the sweep resource with notify true rather than throwing.

113 tests (17 new): clean plane, unmanifested + no-expiry, unmanifested with expiry, two-page pagination with page_size/order_by asserted, short listing, repeated record, 401, 400/403, 5xx and malformed bodies, missing or non-UUID org id (no fetch, no vault read), unresolved vault ref (no fetch), credential inference and explicit credentialId, preflight reservation. A mutation that ends pagination after page 1 fails the pagination test. Fixtures are fictional.
Read-only GETs. Each run overwrites instance sweep-scaleway; one resource per run.

GET /iam/v1alpha1/api-keys with organization_id, page, page_size=100, order_by=created_at_asc; requires api_keys[] and numeric total_count, validates each access_key against SCW + 17, and parses expires_at strictly. Pagination is capped at 100 pages and treated as unreachable past that. Not yet exercised against the live API: the acceptance run in the consumer repo is the live contract check.
Every non-2xx path cancels the response body; AbortSignal.timeout per request.
README and tests use placeholder org (all-zero UUID), placeholder vault names and SCWEXAMPLE... key ids. No internal host, vault or key ids in the diff.

SweepSchema and SweepKeySchema are plain z.object; bearerType is an enum; plane is a literal. The new global argument defaults to empty and is validated as a UUID at run time, reported as misconfigured.
New `sweep` spec: lifetime infinite, garbageCollection 30, matching the existing specs.
Read-only monitoring methods by design; nothing to create, update or delete.

Nothing mutates. Configuration problems are checked before any request, and the organization id before the vault is read (a sweep that cannot list anything reads no secret; tested). All are recorded as misconfigured/authFailed. preflight now also reserves the sweep-scaleway instance name.
Fixed instance sweep-scaleway, reserved in preflight so no credential id can normalise to it and be read by data.latest() in its place.
The manifest set is derived from the model's own scaleway-key subjects (parseScalewaySubject); no extra data read.
Model version 2026.10.22.1 with a no-op upgrade entry describing the additive change; manifest version bumped to match.
